title: Geometric Algebra Planes: Convex Implicit Neural Volumes
scoped_summary: Moving feature gates invalidate the core semiconvex landscape guarantee; an independent local singular-value lower-bound defect is Minor. Fully convex Eq5 survives the checked argument.

problems.title: Moving gates invalidate the semiconvex optimization guarantee
problems.source_claim: Eq4 objective is separately convex in feature grids and decoder; semiconvex model has no nonglobal local minima
problems.location: PDF p4 Sec3.2 Eq4; pp1-2 contributions; p14 Appendix A.1
assumptions: Real unconstrained grid and decoder parameters
Feature dimensions1; resolutions2; h1 admitted by stated definition
Finite direct MSE supervision target1 within interpolation domain
Constant first line grid z and other six grids0
problems.suspect_step: Frozen decoder gating weights do not freeze a gate whose input is the trainable feature vector

check.kind: analytic counterexample with independent finite arithmetic
check.stated_consequence: Separate grid convexity and all local minima global
check.calculation: L(z)=(1-z*1[z>=0])^2; L(-1)=1,L(0)=1,L(1)=0; midpoint1>endpoint mean0.5. Strict negative gate at z=-1 persists in an open neighborhood of all trainable parameters, giving a non-strict local minimum of loss1 versus global loss0.
check.result: Separate convexity false; nonglobal non-strict local minima exist

counterevidence: Fully convex Eq5 explicitly uses separately frozen gate grids and remains convex under convex loss
Freezing feature map inside gate would change Eq4; PDF and code show moving features
Empirical stability can remain accurate; historical experiment provenance not established
problems.impact: Core semiconvex optimization guarantee and theoretical explanation of initialization-independent optimization fail; no benchmark score loss or strict local minimum claimed

correction.statement: Freezing both gate weights and gate feature map restores separate convexity under convex loss; no full global-minimum guarantee is established for that modified bilinear model
correction.verification: analytic observation only; full repair not certified

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: Equation (4) freezes the gating weights but retains trainable features inside the gate. The admitted constant-grid direct-MSE example satisfies the stated dimensions and interpolation.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: L(-1)=L(0)=1 and L(1)=0 violate Jensen; strict closed gates give an open nonglobal local-minimum plateau in the full parameter space. Static release agrees with moving features. Equation (5)'s separately frozen-feature convex alternative survives.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Major: the false separate-convexity and all-local-minima-global guarantee is a core advertised optimization contribution.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: Freezing features changes the model and only restores the stated convexity property; no complete repair of the original landscape guarantee is certified.

problems.title: The printed rank-k singular-value lower bound excludes an exact fit
assumptions: Complete direct Frobenius supervision at grid locations
problems.suspect_step: Uses kth rather than omitted singular-value tail in a rank-k error bound

check.kind: exact rank-one counterexample and finite NumPy arithmetic
check.calculation: g1 alpha g2^T=M; optimal error0; singular values1,0; printed RHS sigma1=1
check.result: 0>=1 false; same contradiction for squared norm

counterevidence: Theorem1 Eq7 and Appendix Eq18 correctly permit the exact fit
A nonstandard residual-tail meaning of sigma would need an explicit definition absent from A.4
problems.impact: Local lower-bound expression invalid; no central dependence of factorization theorem or experimental conclusions on this bound established

correction.statement: For unrestricted rank-k matrices under full Frobenius supervision, optimal error=(sum_{j>k} sigma_j(M)^2)^(1/2), hence E>=sigma_{k+1}; squared error uses tail sum
correction.verification: Standard SVD upper/lower rank argument and exact-fit check; neighboring low-resolution bounds not certified

acceptance_check.truth_and_assumptions: Equation (50)'s printed one-based sigma_k lower bound excludes an admissible exact rank-k fit.
acceptance_check.decisive_evidence_and_counterevidence: M=diag(1,0), k=1 has exact fit and zero Frobenius error but sigma_1=1. The neighboring factorization identity agrees with the exact fit.
acceptance_check.core_dependency_and_severity: Minor: a local false numerical lower bound without established dependence of the main parameterization or experiments on it.
acceptance_check.correction_scope: Use the Frobenius singular-value tail (and its sigma_(k+1) lower bound) in the stated unrestricted rank-k setting; neighboring resolution bounds remain outside this repair.

limitations: Scope excludes empirical replication, training-failure frequency and provenance of published experiment commit
No full audit of neighboring lower bounds or all maximum-attainable-rank statements
Additional OpenReview material and later errata not inspected
repair_verification: P1 incomplete; P2 verified only for unrestricted pure rank-k Frobenius model
